title: Senior Cloud Native Architect (Multi-Cloud & API Gateway)高级云原生架构师 (多云与网关方向)
body: Position Overview Focus on dual-cloud architecture covering global AWS and domestic Alibaba Cloud, driving evolution of cross-region networking, storage, compute and Service Mesh systems. What We Are Building 1.TripoAI is building a world-leading generative AI platform for 3D content creation. Our user base spans the globe, which demands an underlying infrastructure built with a fully global mindset. 2.For the Infrastructure team, our mission goes far beyond merely keeping systems online — we aim to redefine cloud computing architecture for the AI era. 3.We are seeking a cloud-native architect proficient in both global AWS and domestic Alibaba Cloud to build a highly available, low-latency global compute and traffic foundation. If you are tired of incremental maintenance within a single data center and eager to operate cross-ocean multi-cloud architectures, plus design high-performance gateways capable of processing massive 3D data streams — this is your battlefield. Challenges & Core Responsibilities 1.Multi-cloud & hybrid cloud architecture design Lead the infrastructure development of TripoAI built on global AWS and domestic Alibaba Cloud. Standardize unified access for networking, compute and storage, and abstract away underlying disparities between cloud vendors. 2.Global high-availability gateway Design and iterate high-performance API gateways and algorithm gateways. Manage cross-region traffic scheduling and disaster recovery failover to guarantee ultra-low latency for users worldwide. 3.Service Mesh & microservice governance Collaborate with in-house Mesh specialists to mature the microservice governance framework. Resolve challenges around service discovery, rate limiting, circuit breaking and full-link tracing for over 20 backend engineers working on complex business scenarios. 4.Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Promote automation tools such as Terraform to enable instant provisioning and standardized management of global infrastructure resources. 定位：主攻全球 AWS + 国内阿里云的双云架构，解决跨域网络、存储、计算以及 Service Mesh 的演进。 【我们在做什么】 1、TripoAI 正在构建全球领先的 3D 生成式 AI 平台。我们的用户遍布全球，这意味着我们需要一套真正具备全球化视野的底层架构。 2、对于 Infra 团队，我们的使命不仅是“系统不挂”，而是重新定义 AI 时代的云计算架构。 3、我们需要一位能在全球 AWS 和国内阿里云之间游刃有余的云原生架构师，来构建高可用、低延迟的全球算力与流量底座。 如果你厌倦了在单一机房里修修补补，渴望操盘横跨大洋的多云架构，设计支撑海量 3D 数据流的高性能网关，这里是你的战场。 【你将面临的挑战与职责】 1、多云与混合云架构设计：主导 TripoAI 基于全球 AWS 和国内阿里云的基础设施建设，统一网络、计算和存储的标准化接入，屏蔽底层云厂商差异。 2、全球化高可用网关：设计并演进高性能的 API 网关与算法网关，处理跨区域（Multi-Region）的流量调度、容灾切换，确保全球用户访问的极低延迟。 3、Service Mesh 与微服务治理：与现有的 Mesh 专家配合，深化微服务治理体系，解决 20+ 后端工程师在复杂业务场景下的服务发现、限流熔断与全链路追踪。 4、基础设施即代码 (IaC)：推行 Terraform 等自动化工具，实现全球基础设施的秒级拉起与标准化管理。 Job Requirements Who We Are Looking For We do not value rigid rote knowledge; we prioritize complex problem-solving capabilities and an entrepreneurial ownership mindset. Hard Core Competencies 1.Hands-on multi-cloud experience Expertise in core product suites of AWS and Alibaba Cloud (VPC, EKS/ACK, S3/OSS, etc.), with proven practical experience in cross-ocean/cross-cloud network interconnection and data synchronization. 2.Cloud-native & gateway expertise Proficient in Go; in-depth understanding of Kubernetes, Envoy/Istio, Nginx and related technologies, with experience building or deeply customizing in-house API gateways. 3.Strong high-concurrency architecture acumen Outstanding system design capabilities, profound comprehension of distributed system consistency and high availability, able to write clean, elegant code recognized by the entire engineering team. What We Offer You 1.Core team impact Flat organizational structure. Every technical decision you make will directly shape product development and business metrics. No cumbersome reporting hierarchies, only fast feedback loops. 2.Steep growth trajectory Work directly on cutting-edge global 3D + AI technical scenarios, tackle industry-wide unsolved challenges, and grow alongside a team of elite technical engineers. 3.AI-first engineering culture We reject meaningless internal competition and advocate an efficient workflow powered by standardized SOPs and AI assistants. New technologies are actively encouraged; we strive to build elegant, well-crafted solutions rather than merely deliver functional ones. 4.Competitive compensation package Beyond base salary, we offer equity tied to the company’s growth, for partners who aim to grow with us long-term. 【我们在寻找这样的你】 我们不看重死记硬背的八股文，我们看重解决复杂问题的能力和创业者的 Owner 意识。 硬核素质： 1、多云实战经验：精通 AWS 和阿里云的核心产品体系（VPC, EKS/ACK, S3/OSS 等），有跨海/跨云网络打通与数据同步的实战经验。 2、云原生与网关技术：精通 Go 语言，深入理解 Kubernetes、Envoy/Istio、Nginx 等技术，有自研或深度定制 API 网关的经验。 3、高并发架构品位：具备优秀的系统设计能力，对分布式系统的一致性、高可用有深刻理解，能写出让团队赞叹的优雅代码。 【你将获得什么】 1、核心团队的影响力：扁平化管理，你的每一个技术决策都能直接影响产品走向和业务数据，没有繁琐的汇报流程，只有极速的反馈闭环。 2、陡峭的成长曲线：直接面对全球最前沿的3D+AI技术场景，解决行业内没有标准答案的难题，与一群技术极客共同进化。 3、AI驱动的极客氛围：我们拒绝低效内卷，推崇“SOP+AI辅助”的高效工作流。在这里，我们鼓励尝试新技术，致力于把事情做漂亮，而不仅仅是做完。 4、有竞争力的回报：除了薪资，我们提供与公司成长绑定的期权，寻找愿意长期同行的伙伴。
